title: Chapter 1054
text:
In the Black Star Palace, the battle between Ames and Traveler was reaching its climax.

Under the control of the force field, the satellite brick was like a gigantic iron fist. It shattered Traveler's magic shield again and again, sending him flying everywhere like a baseball.

It seemed like Ames had the absolute upper hand and was beating Traveler into a pulp. However, she was not happy at all. Instead, she became even more vigilant.

There was a reason why Traveler was so weak. For some reason, he had used Doll Replacement many times. He was selling his health like crazy, and his attributes were dropping like crazy. It was as if he was intentionally hurting himself.

At the same time, the uncomfortable evil aura around him became more and more obvious.

"Things might change if we delay. We can't continue fighting with him." Ames looked around and nodded at the base in the distance.

The officers on the watchtower could see her movement. She was hinting to activate the space-stabilizing trap and cut off Traveler's escape route.

Seeing this, Herlous immediately gave the order.

"The ambush team is in position. Listen up, activate —"

Before he could finish, the situation suddenly changed! Suddenly, Traveler's body exploded with purple and green energy. It was so thick that it looked like a flowing liquid. It looked like the tentacles of an octopus, with particles that looked like suction cups. It also looked like boiling potions that kept bubbling and expanding.

The energy twisted and danced crazily, condensing into translucent greenish-purple energy tentacles that were almost solid. Instead of saying that the Traveler had released the energy, it was more accurate to say that the energy tentacles were pushing open the Traveler's body and trying to squeeze themselves out!

Ames's eyes narrowed. She did not have the habit of watching others transform. Without saying anything, she gathered her force field.

Circles of force field spun rapidly around her like small whirlpools. They quickly turned into the shape of a drill. After pausing for a moment, they suddenly shot toward Traveler.

The next moment, the purple and green energy around Traveler twisted and wrapped around him, forming an outer layer. The force field hit the outer layer but could not penetrate it. It only pushed him a distance away. He looked unscathed.

"Hahahaha, it's useless, useless, useless!"

Traveler laughed like a madman. It was as if he had become a completely different person. His entire being was filled with an indescribable evil aura. He gave off a very filthy feeling.

Just by looking at him, a large number of army warriors felt their hearts palpitating and their breaths short … In the way the interface described it, everyone had passed a willpower test.

Ames kept attacking, but the purple energy surrounding Traveler was extremely tough. It actually blocked all of her attacks. She did not know what kind of energy it was.

At this moment, Traveler suddenly raised his hands high, his eyes filled with eagerness.

"The expert in front of me is the sacrifice your husband has offered to me. Answer my call, my lovely wife!"

Rumble!

Energy blossomed with a loud bang, spreading out endlessly. The black velvet-like space was dyed purple and green, and the two colors intertwined with each other.

The nature of this area changed at this moment.

"Warning! Warning! The space-time coefficient is fluctuating violently, and the wave crest has broken through the stable safety line of reality! "

"Space stabilizer overloaded … Warning! The stabilizing anchor was damaged! Stability failure, requesting an increase in the number of space stabilizers! "

"Analyzing event model … Analysis complete. Match similarity rate: 100%. Event: Secondary Dimension Descends!"

If space was a piece of paper, the space-time stability coefficient would be the degree of wrinkling on the paper. The more stable it was, the smoother the paper would be. At this moment, this piece of paper was crumpled into a ball, and another piece of paper representing a secondary dimension wrapped it up.

Secondary dimensions were dangerous and wonderful, and they were born for different reasons. If they descended into the main universe, they would change the nature of the space in a certain area, turning it into a secondary dimension. Most of the time, this was a disaster.

Han Xiao had once seen a treasure called the Shadow Lantern in the dynasty. The wick of the lantern was a fragment of the Shadow Dimension's origin energy, and its effect was to summon the Shadow Dimension. Traveler's current actions were similar to this ability.

This secondary dimension filled with evil aura slowly opened outside Black Star Palace. Ames and the many fleets were in the dark purple space, as if they had been swallowed by this secondary dimension.

Endless energy tentacles stretched out of thin air, each of them at least 100,000 meters long. They waved unconsciously, and the fleets were smashed into chaos, their shields flashing with electric arcs.

Ames frowned. She controlled her force field and constantly crushed the tentacles, but new tentacles continued to stretch out from this secondary dimension. Seeing this, she could only target Traveler's body and continuously release her force field.

Bang! Bang!

Traveler did not dodge and just floated in place. His palms with purple imprints kept waving, and purple-green waves of energy followed the trajectory of his palms. It was as if the energy was endless, and under his control, it easily extinguished Ames's force field.

"I was once defeated by Oulou and witnessed his terrifying ability. This prompted me to embark on the path of pursuing secondary dimensions." Purple and green lines spread on Traveler's face, and his condition continued to recover. He laughed wildly. "Finally, I found a new power! Let me introduce, this secondary dimension is called Evil Convergence, and it is my wife! In its body, I can absorb endless energy! Tell Black Star to come out. You're no match for me! "

"You haven't defeated me yet."

Ames narrowed her eyes, and a solemn look flashed across her face.

Traveler glanced around and saw countless fleets rising from Black Star Palace, setting up more space stabilization anchors around.

Seeing this, he did not care and smiled coldly.

After causing such a huge commotion, Black Star would definitely not sit back and do nothing. His goal had been achieved, and now it was just a matter of when Black Star would come.

However, he still had to add fuel to the fire and continue to put pressure on Black Star.

With this thought in mind, Traveler looked at Ames and licked his lips.

"Then I'll chew you up first."

…

Emerald Star Cluster, Black Star Corps frontline battlefield.

The appearance of the Radiant Federation attracted the attention of everyone present. They all stopped what they were doing and had different expressions on their faces.

The ones who appeared were the six people led by Sierron, and 'Guardian' Romo, who was providing remote support, was not present.

"One, two … six Beyond Grade As."

Hella's heart sank, and the excitement of opening the Distanceless Life Link quickly faded.

If these people were here to take her life, she felt that she had no chance of surviving.

Even though she was connected to Aurora's life energy, Aurora's stamina was limited, and it would be exhausted sooner or later. With so many Beyond Grade As working together, it was enough to kill her countless times.

The way she saw it, even if her recovery speed was amazing, it was only a matter of time before she died in the face of such overwhelming strength. Plus, having a strong recovery speed did not mean that she would not be controlled or captured by the enemy.

"Sister …" Aurora's anxious call came through telepathy.

Hella felt the life energy continuously flowing out of her body, and her sharp eyes gradually softened. She subconsciously turned to look at Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar in the sky.

When they were besieged earlier, she had analyzed the situation and felt that the only way to save herself was to successfully connect with Aurora. Therefore, during the battle, she had split her attention to cooperate with Aurora and tried to establish a link time and time again.

It was unknown if it was because of the eruption of her potential at the critical moment of life and death, or for some unknown reason, but the secondary dimension that acted as an obstacle had some changes and gradually stopped absorbing life energy midway. Once this obstacle was eliminated, the link between the two was successfully established. Aurora could finally share her energy with Hella through the soul and bloodline connection.

Just as everyone was watching, the Radiant Federation's fleet moved.

A large number of drones and mechanical troops were dispatched to attack the defense fleet of the planet stronghold. The other spaceships quickly changed their formation. The engineering spaceships came to the edge of the formation, released arc-shaped mechanical parts, and started to assemble the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device. They also needed to encircle the fleet vertically and horizontally.

The six Radiant Beyond Grade As quickly approached the battlefield where Hella and the others were. Sierron crossed his arms, looked down at Hella, Sagman, and the others, and said coldly, "Looks like we arrived at just the right time."

Kasuyi's avatar slowly flew over. "Even Radiant is involved."

"Humph, your Ethereal is really useless. You still haven't killed Hella," Sierron said coldly.

"Since Radiant is here, their goal must be the same as ours. Why don't we work together to kill Hella?" Sagman said with a deep voice. "She just revealed a recovery ability similar to Black Star's. If we work together, we will have a higher chance of killing her."

Hades rolled his eyes and suddenly said, "Alright, since we all have the same goal, let's form an alliance."

Sierron paused, thought about it, and did not explain their true goal.

There were many people in Ethereal, and it was not the right time to reveal their cards. It was best to work together first.

Hearing this, Sagman and the others were overjoyed, but Hella's heart sank.

… Looks like today is the day I die.

This time, Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar landed beside her, took out a new set of compressed orbs for the Crimson Snake First Generation mechanical suit, opened it instantly, and helped Hella change her mechanical suit.

Hella looked at him, hesitated for a moment, and said softly in the communication channel.

"Black Star, if I die today, please take care of my sister in the future."

"You won't die today." Han Xiao shook his head.

"There's no need to comfort me. There are more than ten Beyond Grade As here … This situation is even more terrifying than what you faced back then. Even if you come personally, you won't be able to save me … Don't come with your main body. Go, don't save me. You'll be in danger too."

"You won't know until you try." Han Xiao did not comment.

Hella shook her head, paused, and said in a low voice, "I owe you too much. You've been taking care of me for decades … Actually, I'm really thankful to you."

Han Xiao looked sideways. "Why are you suddenly saying your last words? This is not like you."

"Heh, don't worry, I won't wait for death. Even if I die, I'll cause the greatest damage to the enemy … I've been chasing after your back, and before I die, I'm finally qualified to stand beside you and fight side by side with you. I'm already very satisfied."

Hella subconsciously reached out her hand, but she suddenly stopped halfway. After hesitating for a moment, she changed her action to patting Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar's shoulder and sighed softly.

The next second, her face became as cold as ice again, and energy burst out. Alone, she charged toward the dozen Beyond Grade As in front of her!

She only felt that it was a pity that the one beside her was not Han Xiao's main body.

However, before I die, I should be able to see you one last time …

"Courting death."

Sagman snorted coldly and led his companions to fight Hella again.

In midair, just as Sierron was about to join the battle with his companions, he suddenly sensed danger.

Boom! Boom!

An extremely powerful psychic energy swept past, and the people of Radiance were shocked. They hurriedly used various means to defend themselves, but they were still sent flying. The psychic energy also contained a powerful psychic attack. Many people trembled, and their heads felt like they were about to explode.

This change shocked everyone. Sagman and the other four quickly stopped and looked up in shock. The attacker was their leader, Kasuyi's avatar.

Didn't they already become temporary allies? Why did His Excellency Kasuyi attack the people of Radiance?

Hila's movements also paused, and she was extremely confused.

Strange, why did the enemy suddenly have an internal conflict?

Sierron shook his head and got rid of the slight dizziness. He glared at Kasuyi's avatar not far away.

"What do you mean?"

With his hands behind his back, Kasuyi slowly said, "The goal of Radiance is not just to kill Hella, right? You want to capture her alive and use her as a bargaining chip to force Black Star to do something for you."

Sierron's eyes changed. Kasuyi was so sure that he must have received intelligence. There was no point in pretending anymore, so he did not bother to hide anymore. He coldly said, "Where did you get your intelligence from?"

"Based on your usual style, I can guess," Kasuyi said calmly. "You only interfered in the middle of the battle and even brought the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device. Compared to killing, it's more like kidnapping … The Ten Thousand Deity Scepter is still in your hands. If I'm not wrong, you want to use Hella as a trade in exchange for Black Star to remove the seal on the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter for you."

At this point, Kasuyi's psychic power suddenly surged as if he was angry.

"If it were anything else, it would be fine, but the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter is Ethereal's most precious treasure. The priority is Hella's life and death. Radiance still refuses to give up. Even if I give up the mission today, I'll stop you from kidnapping Hella. No matter what, the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter cannot be used by Radiance!"

Feeling Kasuyi's aura soaring into the sky, Han Xiao immediately looked over.

Damn, Best Actor, you're even making up for it!

This way, even if his actions were reported to the upper echelons of Ethereal, Ethereal would only praise Kasuyi for doing a good job.

He suddenly thought, Wait, this might not be an act. It might be the truth …

Amazing, the highest level of acting is to even believe yourself!

If they don't award you an Oscar, it's because they don't know what's good for them!

(Ps: There was a clerical error in the previous chapter. Radiance sent six people, not seven. One of them was long-range.)

(Also, I'll recommend the book "The Mythical Three Kingdoms". It's a very famous old book. When I read it in the past, it only had three to four million words. Now, it's over ten million words. Poison Grass even healed me to show respect.
